consolidation_proposal.title: Dependency gap: pypdf and python-docx used by core/intake_files.py are undeclared in pyproject.toml and uncatalogued in config/tool-catalog.json
consolidation_proposal.body: [consolidated from BI-PF-1397]: core/intake_files.py imports pypdf (PDF) and python-docx (DOCX) lazily but neither is declared in product-forge/pyproject.toml nor recorded in config/tool-catalog.json. Adding/changing shipped code that imports them would trip the undeclared-dep gate (core/change_policy.undeclared_import_findings, BI-PF-0443). Fix: declare in pyproject [project.optional-dependencies] (e.g. a 'docs'/'extract' extra) and add tool-catalog entries (name+license_id+license_class+bundle_allowed+kind+source). Evidence: core/intake_files.py:88,108.
